items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: On the Swing Street with my sextet that Glaser booked -- with Art Tatum and (inaudible) Laumell Morgan.

ctx.x: I mean, like, when I went with Cab Calloway or went with Louie Armstrong, and the things I did with King and Joe Glaser, you know.
On the Swing Street with my sextet that Glaser booked -- with Art Tatum and (inaudible) Laumell Morgan.
These things was just like -- well this is what I've learned. I learned all these things, you know.
